description: List tables and column schemas on a DataCanvas staged by fema_search_nfip. Call this before fema_dataframe_query to discover the exact table name, column names, and DuckDB data types needed to write valid SQL. Row count reflects what was actually staged — check truncated in the fema_search_nfip response to know whether the canvas holds the full matching set.

canvas_id.description: Canvas ID from the fema_search_nfip response.

name: fema_dataframe_describe

canvas_id.description: Canvas ID that was described — pass to fema_dataframe_query.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `canvas_not_found`: The canvas_id does not correspond to an active canvas session. `canvas_unavailable`: DataCanvas is disabled on this deployment (CANVAS_PROVIDER_TYPE is not set to duckdb). Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

tables.description: All tables and views available on this canvas.

items.description: A single registered table or view on the canvas.

columns.description: All columns in this table, in schema order.

items.description: A single column in the table.

name.description: Column name — use in SELECT, WHERE, GROUP BY, and ORDER BY clauses.

nullable.description: True when the column can contain NULL values. Absent when nullability is unknown.

type.description: DuckDB SQL data type (e.g., VARCHAR, DOUBLE, INTEGER, BOOLEAN).

kind.description: Object type: "table" for a registered data table, "view" for a derived view.

name.description: Table or view name — use this exact string in SQL FROM clauses.

row_count.description: Total rows in this table — the full staged result set, not the inline preview count.

title: Describe FEMA DataCanvas Tables
